title: Immersion Metric2 High Value Outliers
dataSources: Lessons (`lesson:complete`), vocab reviews (`vocab:review`), immersion (`immersion:log`), speaking practice (`speaking:session`).
app: Language-learning telemetry — Duolingo / Babbel lesson exports, Anki spaced-repetition review logs, immersion trackers, and speaking-practice logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=immersion:metric2 value=*
| eventstats perc90(value) as p90, perc10(value) as p10
| where value>=p90 OR value<=p10
| table _time source_id value p90 p10
description: Surfaces the highest and lowest value outliers in immersion metric2 (2) events.
value: Tail events often explain spikes in cost, effort, or risk that averages hide.
implementation: Compute percentile bands on `value` and review extreme immersion metric2 (2) records.
visualization: Scatter plot of value with percentile bands.
grandmaExplanation: It summarises the unusually high or low value moments in your immersion metric2 (2) history.
